title: Improved $L^p$ bounds for the helical maximal function in dimensions $n \geq 5$
summary: Let $n \geq 5$. We prove that the helical maximal operator is bounded on $L^p(\mathbb{R}^n)$ for some $p 2n-4$ obtained by Gan-Maldague-Oh. As observed by Beltran-Hickman, the exponent $2n-4$ is the natural limit of the standard local smoothing method.
